entities.summary:
Thomas Sowell is an American economist, economic historian, and social theorist. With widely published commentary and books—and as a guest on TV and radio—he is a well-known voice in the American conservative movement as a prominent black conservative. He is a senior fellow at the Hoover Institution 
and was a recipient of the National Humanities Medal from President George W. Bush in 2002.
